title: Funding for research into hydrogen resources
summary: Exploratory research work into the commercial viability of hydrogen resources in Southland will be accelerated by a grant of up to $17.8 million from the Regional Infrastructure Fund.

title: Funding for better connections in Kaikōura
summary: Locals and visitors will benefit from improved access in central Kaikōura, with the Government providing a grant of up to $500,000 from the Regional Infrastructure Fund for new facilities.

title: Milford Tourism concession in place for summer
summary: A new concession agreement with Milford Sound Tourism Limited has now been signed – bringing certainty for the iconic tourism destination ahead of summer.

title: Geothermal exploration for Taranaki and Waikato
summary: Two Māori-led early exploration projects in Taranaki and South Waikato could unlock new geothermal opportunities beyond New Zealand’s established geothermal areas, supporting regional growth and making greater use of home-grown energy resources.

title: Wairarapa grain storage set to benefit farmers
summary: A $1.55 million loan from the Regional Infrastructure Fund will support the establishment of a new grain drying and storage facility in Carterton, improving costs, efficiencies, and resilience.

title: Foxton wetland restoration backed by RIF
summary: The restoration and development of Piriharakeke, the river loop at Foxton, will be supported by a grant of up to $3 million from the Regional Infrastructure Fund.

title: Regional radio strengthened for emergencies
summary: The Government is investing in the resilience of independent radio broadcasters to help ensure regional communities can access vital emergency information when electricity, internet or telecommunications services are disrupted.

title: Government backs regional airline Air Napier
summary: The Government is continuing its support for regional air services with an $845,000 loan to Hawke’s Bay airline Air Napier.

title: Govt nurturing New Zealand’s seed supply chain
summary: The government is supporting infrastructure investment in Central Hawkes Bay for a grower-led seed cleaning, processing and storage facility.

title: Government backing Whale Trail tourism venture
summary: The Government is investing up to $12 million to connect Picton to the Whale Trail cycling and walking track.

title: Making best use of railway land
summary: The Government has extended KiwiRail's leas of railway land by 100 years (to 2170). This provides greater certainty for KiwiRail so it can develop commercial lease opportunities for vacant or unutilised land.
